name: yi-sdlc
description: Yaroslav's user-level Claude Code kit for Windows: the full SDLC pipeline (the sdlc plugin by Kyrylo Genkov, imported under the yi-sdlc namespace: 21 skills and 11 agents from map-architecture and interview to ship-feature), tracker-agnostic ticket skills (implement-fix, implement-change, implement-feature) with YouTrack and Jira adapters, driven by a per-repo profile and run in parallel Rider tabs (or the invoking session), run-application (the app from any worktree on its own ports, with checked links), commit conventions, complete (commit, PR and merge after green builds in one word), a desktop dialog for Claude's questions, and toast notifications.
